name: Itazura Satsuei
source:
Main character is a teacher who is tasked to create a school promotional video. He chooses female student Mika as an assistant during the shooting. But Mika is different from ordinary girls as she has no shyness of her body. And eventually the impulse of forbidden fruit prevails.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名负责制作学校宣传视频的教师。他选择女学生美香担任拍摄助手。但美香与普通女孩不同，对自己的身体毫不羞涩。最终，禁果的诱惑占据上风。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]）
